regimeSub: Sep CPI +4.0% YoY smashes 3.7% est, reigniting Oct rate hike odds as SPX dumps 1.1%.
themes: Sep CPI prints 4.0% YoY vs 3.7% est per Reuters Oct 14 → 10Y eases 3bp to 5.21% on flight-to-safety bid but 2Y holds 4.79% as Fed funds futures reprice Oct hike probability; core PCE still 3.0% leaves Warsh no room to pivot

SPX -1.1% from 7805 to 7718 as equity risk premium collapses vs 5%+ yields → VIX +32bp to 16.87 but remains subdued; Goldman 'Goldilocks' Oct 12 thesis invalidated by hot CPI forcing Warsh tightening bias per Sep 15 PBS remarks

Brent -2.0% to $104.29 as OPEC cuts demand forecasts per The Hill Oct 13 and Iran production crashes below 2mbpd per IranWire → Saudi backfilling offset by slowing global demand; gold -0.2% to $4183 as dollar DXY retreats to 101.91 post-CPI

KOSPI -9.8% to 5539 as BOK Gov Shin's Oct 12 apology and President's 'unavoidable hikes' comment per BigGo Finance spark contagion → won weakens to 1350 from 1337; SK Hynix ADR-Korea arb unwinds as AI capex cycle questions resurface

signalNotes.note: 10Y 5.21% minus Sep CPI 4.0% = 1.21% real rate; compressed from 1.54% as inflation overshoots.

signalNotes.note: 2s10s at +42bp maintains bear steepening bias; curve pricing terminal rate higher for longer.

signalNotes.note: HY spreads stable but equity selloff suggests credit lagging; watch for contagion if SPX breaks 7600.

signalNotes.name: VIX
signalNotes.note: VIX 16.87 up from ~15 pre-CPI; subdued vol despite 1.1% SPX drop signals put sellers still active.

signalNotes.note: Brent $104.29 -2% as Iran output collapse offset by Saudi ramp; OPEC demand cuts weigh.

signalNotes.name: Gold
signalNotes.note: Gold $4183 flat as DXY retreat to 101.91 offsets higher real rate drag post-CPI miss.

signalNotes.name: USD / KRW
signalNotes.note: Won weakens to 1350 as BOK independence crisis and KOSPI -9.8% rout triggers EM FX contagion.

signalNotes.name: Semiconductor SOX
signalNotes.note: KOSPI memory selloff pressures SOX; SK Hynix ADR-Korea arb unwind questions AI capex durability.

headline: Hot September CPI at 4.0% resurrects Fed hike risk, triggering SPX -1.1% and KOSPI -10% rout as Warsh tightening cycle extends into Q4.
